UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Information about a user, including their name, avatar, gamification status, and circle memberships.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

displayName.description: The display name chosen by the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

avatarUrl.description: Optional URL to the user's selected avatar.

role.description: The role in the family, e.g., Parent, Child, Grandparent.

circleId.description: The ID of the Family Circle this user belongs to, if any.

xp.description: The user's experience points for completing chores.

level.description: The current gamified level of the user.

pushToken.description: The device push notification ID / registration token for simulations.

Circle.title: Family Circle
Circle.description: A family circle representing a group of people who share chores and routines.

id.description: The unique ID of the Circle.

name.description: The name of the family circle.

code.description: The invite code (e.g. FAM-123456) for joining.

createdById.description: The UID of the user who created this circle.

Task.title: Family Task
Task.description: A chore, routine, exercise, or goal assigned to users within a circle.

id.description: The unique ID of the task.

title.description: Title of the task or chore.

description.description: Description of what needs to be done.

category.description: Chore, Daily Routine, Exercise, or Goal.

assignedTo.description: List of user UIDs assigned to this task.

deadlineDate.description: Optional specific due date (for monthly or goals).

lastCompletedBy.description: UID of the user who last completed it.

streak.description: Current completion streak for recurring tasks.

TaskLog.title: Task Completion Log
TaskLog.description: Historical record of task completions inside a circle, used for points, statistics, and feed.

id.description: The unique ID of the log.

taskId.description: The ID of the completed task.

completedByEmoji.description: Avatar emoji of the completing user.

xpAwarded.description: The XP awarded to the user.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile collection holding gamification state and settings.

/circles/{circleId}.description: Circles collection representing different family units.

/circles/{circleId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Tasks associated with a particular family circle.

/circles/{circleId}/logs/{logId}.description: Audit trail of task completions within a family circle for ledger and feed.
